data.title: Bitcoin is back, but potential Clarity Act fail and Dem midterms win could come for crypto prices
data.description: Bitcoin's price has been rallying, but it's still down in 2026. Failure of the Clarity Act ahead of Democratic gains in the midterms could be new headwinds.
